Ivy: Quick note: PR #4978 updates the migration guide and adds SDK snippets for `route_priority`. Need docs review + merge before v0.9.2 cutoff (Thu 11:59pm PT). Preview shows link-check error.

Noah: I can review the content. Is this gated?

Ivy: Yes, behind `routing.region_priority_v2`. Docs should be in `version: v0.9` and unversioned.

Rohit: Link-check is failing on `/dev/runtime/kv-cache#notes` returning 502. Maybe switch to `/dev/runtime/kv-cache` anchor-less.

Noah: Also update the JS snippet to use `client.route({priority: 'latency'})` instead of the old `client.send()` example.

Rohit: I'll push a tiny patch for the link and JS snippet.

ci-bot: Tip: rerun preview with `gh workflow run docs-preview.yml -f pr=4978`.

Ivy: Release-captain: can we aim for 6pm PT Thu merge to allow QA verification?

release-captain: Yes please target 6pm PT. Anything later risks missing the RC.

Rohit: Patch pushed, added `version: v0.9`, swapped snippet, removed anchor.

ci-bot: Preview passed on rerun. Link-check green. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/4978

Noah: Content LGTM. Approving now.

Ivy: Approved + merging once CI finishes deploy.

QA-lead: QA harness will pick up the preview URL automatically; scheduling smoke tests after merge.

ci-bot: PR merged and staged.
